name: Bucket Protocol BUCK
oneLiner: BUCK is Bucket Protocol's legacy Sui stablecoin. Bucket's current V2 stablecoin is USDB; the official migration converts BUCK to USDB 1:1.
collateral: SUI, BTC, ETH, and LSTs via CDPs; USDC/USDT via Peg Stability Module
pegMechanism: Legacy BUCK used overcollateralized CDPs, collateral redemption, a USDC/USDT Peg Stability Module, and Tank liquidations. Bucket now offers fee-free 1:1 BUCK-to-USDB migration; its documented phase 2 is exit-only with BUCK minting disabled.
